fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid in north
fields.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plain; some hills and low mountains
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dusty harmattan wind may affect north from December to March
fields.resources: small offshore oil deposits, limestone, marble, timber
fields.farm: cassava, yams, maize, oil palm fruit, cotton, soybeans, rice, pineapples, tomatoes, chillies/peppers
fields.exports: gold, cotton, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews, soybeans, wood
fields.industries: textiles, food processing, construction materials, cement
fields.languages: 55 languages; French (official); Fon (a Gbe language), Yom (a Gur language) and Yoruba are the most important indigenous languages in the south…
fields.religions: Muslim 27.7%, Roman Catholic 25.5%, Protestant 13.5% (Celestial 6.7%, Methodist 3.4%, other Protestant 3.4%), Vodoun 11.6%, other Christian 9.5%, other traditional religions 2.6%, other 2.6%, none…
fields.legal: civil law system modeled largely on the French system and some customary law
fields.military: 18-30 years of age for voluntary and selective compulsory military service for men and women; compulsory service is 18 months
